name: What is the process for insulating an existing attic?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for insulating an existing attic?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for insulating an existing attic typically begins with an inspection to assess current insulation levels and identify any air leaks. Existing old or damaged insulation might need to be removed. Air sealing is often performed next to prevent air leakage. Finally, new insulation, such as blown-in cellulose or fiberglass, is installed to achieve the recommended R-value. Proper ventilation is also crucial and checked during this process.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, potential old insulation removal, air sealing, and then installing new insulation to the recommended R-value.
